sentences.en: Hi, I'm Andrew Ross-Sorkin.
sentences.zh: 嗨，我是安德鲁·罗斯·索金。

sentences.en: I cover business and policy for DealBook, a daily newsletter at the
sentences.zh: 我为《纽约时报》的每日简报《DealBook》报道商业和政策新闻。

sentences.en: New York Times.
sentences.zh: 《纽约时报》。

sentences.en: On November 18th, I'm going to be interviewing some of the most consequential leaders in business, politics, and culture, including J.D.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我将在纽约市举行的 DealBook 峰会上现场采访一些商业、政治和文化领域最具影响力的人物，包括 J.D.

sentences.en: Vance, Elon Musk, Christine
sentences.zh: 万斯、埃隆·马斯克、克里斯汀·

sentences.en: Lagarde, Zylran Mondani, and many others, live on stage at the DealBook Summit in New York City.
sentences.zh: 拉加德、齐尔兰·蒙达尼等许多人。

sentences.en: You can watch some of these unguarded, unfiltered conversations as they happen.
sentences.zh: 您可以实时观看其中一些未经修饰、未经剪辑的对话。

sentences.en: We're going to be live-streaming select interviews for anyone to watch free at nytimes.com on November 18th.
sentences.zh: 11月18日，我们将在 nytimes.com 上直播部分精选采访，供所有人免费观看。

sentences.en: If you're not already a subscriber, you can download the New York Times app to watch and get a month of free access to all of our journalism.
sentences.zh: 如果您还不是订阅用户，可以下载《纽约时报》应用程序进行观看，并获得我们所有新闻内容一个月的免费访问权限。

sentences.en: I hope you'll tune in.
sentences.zh: 希望您能收看。

sentences.en: You won't want to miss it.
sentences.zh: 您一定不想错过。

sentences.en: From the New York Times, I'm Megan Tuohy.
sentences.zh: 我是《纽约时报》的梅根·图伊。

sentences.en: This is The Daily.
sentences.zh: 这是《每日新闻》节目。

sentences.en: Early in the pandemic, nursing homes, jails, and meatpacking plants were the sites of coronavirus outbreaks across the country.
sentences.zh: 疫情初期，疗养院、监狱和肉类加工厂是全国各地新冠病毒爆发的重灾区。

sentences.en: Now, as some students have returned to campuses for the fall semester, the new hotspots are colleges and universities.
sentences.zh: 现在，随着一些学生返校开始秋季学期，新的热点地区变成了大专院校。

sentences.en: My colleague, Natasha Singer, has the story of one school and one student.
sentences.zh: 我的同事娜塔莎·辛格带来了关于一所学校和一名学生的故事。

sentences.en: It's Wednesday, September 16th.
sentences.zh: 今天是9月16日，星期三。

sentences.en: So, Natasha, tell me how you came to find Zoe.
sentences.zh: 那么，娜塔莎，告诉我你是怎么找到佐伊的。

sentences.en: So, in August, we started receiving what I would call these SOS messages from students at universities.
sentences.zh: 八月份的时候，我们开始收到一些我称之为来自大学生的“求救信号”。

sentences.en: We got these messages because we have a system called tip jar where readers who want to be whistleblowers or who just have complaints or who want to give us tips
sentences.zh: 我们收到这些信息是因为我们有一个叫“爆料箱”的系统，那些想要举报、有投诉或想提供线索的读者，

sentences.en: about things to look into can write to us anonymously.
sentences.zh: 都可以匿名写信给我们，告诉我们应该调查哪些事情。

sentences.en: So, these messages started coming from different campuses of college students who were sequestered in these special dorms for students who test positive for coronavirus.
sentences.zh: 于是，这些信息开始从不同的校园传来，都是那些被隔离在专门宿舍里的大学生，他们的新冠病毒检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: And they were describing being kind of trapped in these filthy conditions in quarantine dorms with like dead bugs and mold in the walls and like leaking bathrooMs. But also,
sentences.zh: 他们描述说自己被困在隔离宿舍里，环境非常肮脏，墙上有死虫子和霉菌，浴室还在漏水。而且，

sentences.en: they felt like they'd been abandoned, that the university had sort of cut them off to keep them from being contagious and infecting anybody else and then forgotten about them.
sentences.zh: 他们感觉自己被遗弃了，学校为了防止他们传染给别人，把他们隔离开来，然后就把他们忘了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Good morning, TikTok.
sentences.zh: 早上好，TikTok。

sentences.en: So, I'm quarantined in my NYU dorm room for two weeks and I can't leave and they bring us meals every day.
sentences.zh: 我现在在纽约大学的宿舍里隔离两周，不能离开，他们每天给我们送饭。

sentences.en: And so, I decided I would try to find some students who were in quarantine and isolation on college campuses.
sentences.zh: 所以，我决定试着找一些在大学校园里进行隔离的学生。

sentences.en: It's 11.15 and I just got my breakfaSt. So, let's see what it is because so far the food has been questionable.
sentences.zh: 现在是11点15分，我刚拿到早餐。来看看是什么，因为到目前为止，食物质量都很可疑。

sentences.en: And I went to TikTok because we'd been seeing all these videos of kids on TikTok complaining about bad meals for breakfast that was delivered at 12.30.
sentences.zh: 我去了 TikTok，因为我们一直在上面看到孩子们抱怨12点半才送来的早餐很难吃。

sentences.en: Warm grape juice, mystery vegan muffin, oat bar, and unripe orange.
sentences.zh: 温热的葡萄汁、神秘的纯素松饼、燕麦棒和未熟的橙子。

sentences.en: Is anyone else who goes to the University of Michigan just like, what the fuck is happening right now?
sentences.zh: 还有密歇根大学的学生觉得，这到底是什么鬼情况吗？

sentences.en: And like, terrified of like...
sentences.zh: 而且，很害怕……

sentences.en: In addition to that, there were these students who were complaining about more profound things.
sentences.zh: 除此之外，还有一些学生在抱怨更严重的问题。

sentences.en: I think NYU saw my TikTok last night because it is currently 2 p.m.
sentences.zh: 我想纽约大学昨晚看到我的 TikTok 了，因为现在已经是下午2点了，

sentences.en: and they have not fed me all day.
sentences.zh: 他们一整天都没给我送吃的。

sentences.en: We were given almost no supplies.
sentences.zh: 我们几乎没得到任何补给。

sentences.en: We were given no food, no masks, no gloves, no microwave, no bed sheets, no soap, no cleaning supplies, nothing.
sentences.zh: 没有食物、口罩、手套、微波炉、床单、肥皂、清洁用品，什么都没有。

sentences.en: And while I was looking at students who were more concerned, NYU, I'm sorry if I hurt your feelings, please feed me.
sentences.zh: 在我关注那些更担心的学生时，纽约大学，如果我伤害了你的感情我很抱歉，请给我喂点吃的。

sentences.en: I saw videos by this student at the University of Alabama.
sentences.zh: 我看到了阿拉巴马大学的一名学生发的视频。

sentences.en: Hey y'all, this is day one of quarantine.
sentences.zh: 嘿大家，这是隔离的第一天。

sentences.en: I found out today that I have COVID and now my university has sent me to a small apartment by myself for 14 days.
sentences.zh: 我今天发现我得了新冠，现在学校把我送到一个小公寓里独自隔离14天。

sentences.en: So...
sentences.zh: 所以……

sentences.en: And her name is Zoe Terry.
sentences.zh: 她的名字叫佐伊·特里。

sentences.en: And she was just documenting her experience being isolated in the storm by herself.
sentences.zh: 她一直在记录自己独自在宿舍隔离的经历。

sentences.en: Okay, not going to lie, this apartment is kind of scary, but we're just going to go with it.
sentences.zh: 好吧，说实话，这个公寓有点吓人，但我们只能接受了。

sentences.en: They also gave me three waters.
sentences.zh: 他们还给了我三瓶水。

sentences.en: I'll keep all updated on how I'm doing.
sentences.zh: 我会随时更新我的情况。

sentences.en: And she was upbeat and she has this huge smile and she's completely charming, but the conditions behind her were very bleak, it seemed.
sentences.zh: 她很乐观，笑容灿烂，非常有魅力，但她身后的环境看起来非常凄凉。

sentences.en: So I went to the University of Alabama
sentences.zh: 所以我去了阿拉巴马大学的

sentences.en: Directory and I looked up every student named Zoe.
sentences.zh: 通讯录，查了每一个叫佐伊的学生。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: And then, you know, I found this Zoe and I just sent her an email saying, you know, I'd like to know what it's like.
sentences.zh: 然后，你知道，我找到了这个佐伊，给她发了封邮件，说我想了解一下那里的情况。

sentences.en: I want to know what your experience was like in that isolation dorm.
sentences.zh: 我想知道你在隔离宿舍里的经历是什么样的。

sentences.en: And who is Zoe?
sentences.zh: 佐伊是谁？

sentences.en: Zoe is a sophomore at the University of Alabama in Tuscaloosa.
sentences.zh: 佐伊是塔斯卡卢萨阿拉巴马大学的一名大二学生。

sentences.en: My name is Zoe Terry.
sentences.zh: 我叫佐伊·特里。

sentences.en: I'm 19 years old.
sentences.zh: 我19岁。

sentences.en: I'm from Birmingham, Alabama.
sentences.zh: 我来自阿拉巴马州伯明翰。

sentences.en: So last year, she joined a sorority and she was living, you know, in a freshman dorm and looking forward to the fall.
sentences.zh: 去年，她加入了姐妹会，住在新生宿舍里，对秋季学期充满期待。

sentences.en: But right before spring break, the coronavirus began to spread.
sentences.zh: 但在春假前夕，新冠病毒开始蔓延。

sentences.en: And then once I went home, within the hour of being home, they emailed us and told us that we weren't coming back.
sentences.zh: 我回家后不到一小时，他们就发邮件告诉我们不用回学校了。

sentences.en: And they never came back to school because the coronavirus shut down the campus.
sentences.zh: 他们再也没能回到学校，因为新冠病毒导致校园关闭了。

sentences.en: And so how did you feel about that when that happened?
sentences.zh: 那件事发生时，你是什么感觉？

sentences.en: I was very upset.
sentences.zh: 我非常难过。

sentences.en: Me and all my friends were kind of devastated because we were just getting into the hang of like college life.
sentences.zh: 我和朋友们都感到很崩溃，因为我们才刚刚适应大学生活。

sentences.en: But I kind of was more freaked out because I didn't know like if I need to start getting my stuff ready at home to be living at home or anything like that,
sentences.zh: 但我更害怕，因为我不知道是否需要开始整理家里的东西，准备长期住下去，

sentences.en: because my mom lived in a two bedroom apartment with my twin brother and her.
sentences.zh: 因为我妈妈和我双胞胎哥哥住在一个两居室的公寓里。

sentences.en: So and she stayed at home with her mom and they, you know, kind of banded together to wait this out.
sentences.zh: 所以她和妈妈待在家里，他们团结一致，等待疫情过去。

sentences.en: I convinced my mom to let me get a dog.
sentences.zh: 我说服妈妈让我养了一只狗。

sentences.en: And that was kind of all I did the entire quarantine.
sentences.zh: 那几乎是我整个隔离期间做的事。

sentences.en: I just watched my dog grow up basically.
sentences.zh: 我基本上就是看着我的狗长大。

sentences.en: And what's the status of Zoe's sophomore year?
sentences.zh: 佐伊大二学年的情况如何？

sentences.en: Is the university making plans to reopen?
sentences.zh: 学校有重新开放的计划吗？

sentences.en: So in June, Kay Ivey, who's the governor of Alabama, announced this incredibly ambitious program to reopen the public colleges and universities in the entire state.
sentences.zh: 六月份，阿拉巴马州州长凯·艾维宣布了一项雄心勃勃的计划，旨在重新开放全州的公立大专院校。

sentences.en: And she puts up federal money,
sentences.zh: 她投入了联邦资金，

sentences.en: $30 million from like federal emergency coronavirus response funds to create this program to test every
sentences.zh: 从联邦新冠疫情应急响应基金中拨出3000万美元，建立这个项目，为每一位

sentences.en: single student returning to college in Alabama for coronavirus before they get to school.
sentences.zh: 返回阿拉巴马州上学的学生在入校前进行新冠病毒检测。

sentences.en: And that could be, you know, 150,000 students.
sentences.zh: 那可能涉及15万名学生。

sentences.en: And how are they going to do that?
sentences.zh: 他们打算怎么做？

sentences.en: We keep reading about all the shortages in testing.
sentences.zh: 我们一直在读关于检测短缺的新闻。

sentences.en: How are you going to test over 150,000 students?
sentences.zh: 你们怎么检测超过15万名学生？

sentences.en: It's actually a fascinating story because one of the University of Alabama schools, University of Alabama at Birmingham is a major
sentences.zh: 这其实是一个引人入胜的故事，因为阿拉巴马大学系统中的一所学校——阿拉巴马大学伯明翰分校，是一个主要的

sentences.en: academic medical center and has a major medical school.
sentences.zh: 学术医疗中心，拥有大型医学院。

sentences.en: The governor asked University of Alabama at Birmingham to take on this colossal testing of every returning college student.
sentences.zh: 州长要求阿拉巴马大学伯明翰分校承担起检测每一位返校大学生的艰巨任务。

sentences.en: And so they ramped up their capacity to test and they ramped up to be able to process 10 to 12,000 student coronavirus tests a day.
sentences.zh: 于是他们提高了检测能力，每天能够处理1万到1.2万份学生新冠病毒检测样本。

sentences.en: They also set up this kind of military level logistics where they opened 13 coronavirus testing sites for students around the state.
sentences.zh: 他们还建立了军事级别的后勤保障，在全州为学生开设了13个新冠病毒检测点。

sentences.en: And students had to be tested up to two weeks before they returned to campus.
sentences.zh: 学生必须在返校前两周内接受检测。

sentences.en: And the University of Alabama president and others, as they were describing this, you know, promised that they would be the safest campuses in America when these Alabama schools
sentences.zh: 阿拉巴马大学校长和其他人在描述这些时承诺，当这些学校

sentences.en: reopened.
sentences.zh: 重新开放时，它们将成为美国最安全的校园。

sentences.en: And so during the summer, while all these students are getting tested, where is Alabama in terms of infections?
sentences.zh: 那么在夏天，当所有学生都在接受检测时，阿拉巴马州的感染情况如何？

sentences.en: So by August, when the University of Alabama was gearing up to reopen, Alabama had the seventh highest per capita infection rate in the United States.
sentences.zh: 到八月份阿拉巴马大学准备重新开放时，阿拉巴马州的人均感染率在美国排名第七。

sentences.en: And it was a calculated risk, but they felt their program was comprehensive and that they would be able to safely reopen.
sentences.zh: 这是一个经过计算的风险，但他们认为自己的计划很全面，能够安全地重新开放。

sentences.en: And what about Zoe?
sentences.zh: 那佐伊呢？

sentences.en: Is she feeling like this is a risk?
sentences.zh: 她觉得这有风险吗？

sentences.en: I guess a couple weeks before school started, I was like, I felt more comfortable with the idea of going back to school because everybody had to get tested before they
sentences.zh: 我想在开学前几周，我觉得对返校这件事更放心了，因为每个人在被允许返校之前都必须接受检测。

sentences.en: even were allowed to return on campus.
sentences.zh: 所以佐伊要回学校，也必须接受阿拉巴马州其他大学生都要做的检测。

sentences.en: So for Zoe to go back to school, she also had to get one of these tests that every other college student in Alabama was going to take.
sentences.zh: 结果是阴性。

sentences.en: And it came back negative.
sentences.zh: 所以我被允许回学校了。

sentences.en: So I was allowed to come to school.
sentences.zh: 她在开学前提前返校，因为她要参加姐妹会的招新活动，帮助面试和筛选一年级

sentences.en: And she comes back to school early before classes start because she is going to participate in sorority rush and help interview and identify the first year
sentences.zh: 学生，也就是明年将加入姐妹会并搬进宿舍的女孩们。

sentences.en: students, the girls who are going to be part of the sorority and move into the house next year.
sentences.zh: 回来后感觉非常奇怪，一切看起来都不同了，因为有社交距离之类的规定。

sentences.en: So coming back, it was super strange and everything looks so different because just social distancing and everything like that.
sentences.zh: 而且，通常这是一个非常热闹的面对面社交聚会，现在他们必须在线上进行招新。

sentences.en: And, um, you know, usually this is a really festive social in-person gathering and now they have to do rush online.
sentences.zh: 他们必须虚拟面试潜在的姐妹会成员，但他们仍然投入了巨大的精力。

sentences.en: They have to interview prospective sorority members virtually, but they still are putting a huge amount of energy into this.
sentences.zh: 佐伊熬夜很晚，然后又起得很早，帮忙组织招新和面试潜在学生。

sentences.en: And Zoe is staying up late and then she's waking up really, really early to help organize the rush and interview the prospective students.
sentences.zh: 所以当你睡眠不足时，你会开始觉得有点不舒服，你明白我的意思吗？

sentences.en: Um, and so when you have lack of sleep, um, you kind of start to feel a little sick, you know what I mean?
sentences.zh: 但我当时想，我不可能感染病毒，因为我遵守了每一项准则。

sentences.en: But I was thinking there was no way I could have had the virus because I was following every guideline.
sentences.zh: 我什么都没做。

sentences.en: I was doing nothing.
sentences.zh: 我24小时待在房间里。

sentences.en: I was in my room 24 seven.
sentences.zh: 过了一两天，我的身体感觉非常虚弱，还发烧了。

sentences.en: And so a day or two went by and my body just felt so weak and so feverish.
sentences.zh: 我给妈妈打了电话，她说你需要去检测一下以确保万无一失。

sentences.en: And I called my mom and she's like, you need to go get tested just to make sure.
sentences.zh: 于是她预约了当天的检测。

sentences.en: And so she gets an appointment to be tested that day.
sentences.zh: 她去了学生健康服务中心，做了新冠病毒检测。结果显示我呈阳性。

sentences.en: And she goes down to student health services and she has a coronavirus teSt. And it told me that I was positive.
sentences.zh: 然后你做了什么？

sentences.en: And then what did you do?
sentences.zh: 我当时真的不知道该怎么办，因为这太新鲜了。

sentences.en: So I wasn't really sure what to do because it was very new.
sentences.zh: 基本上我必须联系阿拉巴马大学的 COVID-19 热线，那里有一个

sentences.en: So basically I had to contact the university of Alabama COVID-19 hotline and like, there's a
sentences.zh: 按钮，上面写着如果你认为自己可能感染了新冠请按此键，如果你是来查询阳性检测结果的请按此键。

sentences.en: button where it's like, if you think you may have COVID press this, if you're calling for positive test results, press this.
sentences.zh: 我按了那个键，被分配了一位个案经理，她通过电话和我交谈。

sentences.en: So then I pressed that and I was assigned a case manager and, um, we just, she talked to me on the phone.
sentences.zh: 我当时有点崩溃。

sentences.en: I, um, was having a little bit of a meltdown.
sentences.zh: 我在哭，呼吸急促，她问我，你还好吗？

sentences.en: Um, I was like crying and hyperventilating and, uh, she was like, are you okay?
sentences.zh: 她说，我知道这很可怕，但你会没事的。

sentences.en: Like, I know this is so scary, but you are going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 我保证我们会度过难关，我会告诉你具体该怎么做。

sentences.en: I promise you we're going to get through this and I will tell you exactly what to do.
sentences.zh: 我说，好的，非常感谢。

sentences.en: And I was like, okay, like, thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 我在电话那头努力让自己平静下来。

sentences.en: And, uh, I was like trying to like calm myself down on the other, um, side of the line.
sentences.zh: 然后她收到一封邮件，说你要搬到这个地方，那里有一个带钥匙的密码箱。

sentences.en: But, and she gets this email saying to her, you're going to move to this place and there's going to be a lockbox with your key.
sentences.zh: 所以我打包了所有的衣服和东西。

sentences.en: So I just packed all my clothes and stuff.
sentences.zh: 我带上了电视机。

sentences.en: I packed my TV.
sentences.zh: 我还带了精油扩香仪之类的有趣的东西，尽量让它住起来像家一样，因为我知道我会非常想家。

sentences.en: Um, and like, I packed like my essential oil diffuser and like fun things like that and try to make it as homey as possible because I was going to be very homesick.
sentences.zh: 我拿到了钥匙，去了那里，打开门，里面空荡荡的。

sentences.en: I knew.
sentences.zh: 我到那里的时候，一个人也没有。

sentences.zh: 我甚至无法想象大一新生们是什么感觉。

sentences.en: I feel so bad for them because they're coming to college and like, this isn't what college is like.
sentences.zh: 我为他们感到难过，因为他们刚上大学，而大学生活本不该是这样的。

sentences.en: Like during rush, I was telling people, I was like, I promise like, this isn't what college is like.
sentences.zh: 在迎新期间，我告诉大家，我说，我保证，大学生活本不该是这样的。

sentences.en: It's so much more fun than this.
sentences.zh: 它比这有趣得多。

sentences.en: And it's going to be okay.
sentences.zh: 一切都会好起来的。

sentences.en: Like, we're going to get through this.
sentences.zh: 我们能挺过去的。

sentences.en: We just have to get over this hump.
sentences.zh: 我们只需要跨过这个坎。

sentences.en: And once everything's better, you know, hopefully we get a vaccine and maybe one day things can go back to normal.
sentences.zh: 一旦一切好转，你知道，希望我们能有疫苗，也许有一天一切能恢复正常。

sentences.en: But until then, we just got to push through this time and hope for things to get better.
sentences.zh: 但在那之前，我们只能咬牙坚持，希望情况会好转。

sentences.en: And what is your understanding of why states and schools like the University of Alabama pushed to do this in the first place?
sentences.zh: 你认为像阿拉巴马大学这样的州和学校当初为什么要推动这样做？

sentences.en: I think that there are multiple factors that affect whether universities decided to reopen or not.
sentences.zh: 我认为有多种因素影响了大学是否决定重新开放。

sentences.en: And there are fascinating calculations that went on about what number or percent of students are going to get the virus and what is an acceptable risk to take.
sentences.zh: 关于有多少比例的学生会感染病毒以及什么是可接受的风险，他们进行了非常复杂的计算。

sentences.en: And we see that some universities, even large state universities, made the decision that they were not going to reopen for in-person instruction.
sentences.zh: 我们看到一些大学，甚至是大型州立大学，做出了不恢复线下教学的决定。

sentences.en: They were not going to bring students back to campus.
sentences.zh: 他们没有让学生回到校园。

sentences.en: Some of them made that decision for the semester.
sentences.zh: 其中一些学校整个学期都做了这个决定。

sentences.en: And some said, look, we're going to spend the first six weeks online and we'll see what happened.
sentences.zh: 还有一些学校说，看，我们先上网课六周，看看情况再说。

sentences.en: And other universities made the calculation that it would be much better to reopen.
sentences.zh: 而其他大学则计算认为重新开放会更好。

sentences.en: It would be better for their financial interests and financial survival.
sentences.zh: 这对他们的经济利益和生存更有利。

sentences.en: It would be better for students who would have a much better experience.
sentences.zh: 这对学生来说会更好，他们的体验也会好得多。

sentences.en: There's nothing that beats in-person interaction.
sentences.zh: 没有什么比面对面的互动更好了。

sentences.en: They were going to, you know, cause education loss and emotional kind of growth loss by not opening.
sentences.zh: 你知道，他们本来打算通过不开放校园来造成教育损失和情感成长方面的缺失。

sentences.en: Can you explain the financial piece of that a little bit more?
sentences.zh: 你能再多解释一下其中的财务部分吗？

sentences.en: The financial calculation?
sentences.zh: 财务方面的考量吗？

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: Well, universities obviously need tuition money and residential hall kind of dorm occupancy money and dining hall money to keep going.
sentences.zh: 嗯，大学显然需要学费收入、宿舍住宿费以及食堂收入来维持运转。

sentences.en: And yes, state schools get state money, but they also need revenue.
sentences.zh: 是的，公立学校确实能得到州政府的拨款，但他们也需要营收。

sentences.en: And so there's a large financial calculation about, you know, are we going to not reopen and lose all that income?
sentences.zh: 所以这里有一个巨大的财务考量，你知道，我们是不重新开放并损失所有这些收入呢？

sentences.en: Or are we going to open and get some of that income?
sentences.zh: 还是我们要开放并获得部分收入？

sentences.en: And are we going to open and get some of that income knowing we're going to close, but at least we'll, we have reaped some of that.
sentences.zh: 我们是否要在明知会关闭的情况下开放，至少这样我们能赚取一部分收入？

sentences.en: So there's a big picture financial driver behind deciding to reopen or not.
sentences.zh: 所以，在决定是否重新开放的背后，有一个宏观的财务驱动因素。

sentences.en: And then there are financial decisions every step of the way, like, okay, we're going to reopen.
sentences.zh: 而且在整个过程中，每一步都有财务决策，比如，好吧，我们要重新开放。

sentences.en: Are we going to reopen at full dorm occupancy and get all that money that we need for residential life?
sentences.zh: 我们是要以宿舍满员的状态重新开放，并获得我们维持住宿生活所需的所有资金吗？

sentences.en: Or are we going to take a hit and actually say only freshmen and seniors can come back and that will allow us to have only one student per room.
sentences.zh: 还是我们要承担损失，宣布只允许大一和大四学生返校，这样我们就能保证每个房间只住一名学生？

sentences.en: And that will really reduce the risk we hope of spread of virus, but we're going to take a financial hit.
sentences.zh: 我们希望这能真正降低病毒传播的风险，但我们也会因此遭受财务损失。

sentences.en: And so we see universities making different calculations.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到各所大学做出了不同的考量。

sentences.en: Some have decided we're not going to test kids.
sentences.zh: 有些学校决定不对学生进行检测。

sentences.en: We're only going to test kids for the virus if they show symptoms or if they've been exposed.
sentences.zh: 我们只会在学生出现症状或接触过病毒时才对他们进行检测。

sentences.en: We see other universities like the University of Illinois at Urbana-Champaign, and they have decided they are going to test every student twice a week.
sentences.zh: 我们看到其他大学，比如伊利诺伊大学厄巴纳-香槟分校，他们决定每周对每位学生进行两次检测。

sentences.en: This is a major state university deciding the only way they can reopen safely is to test every student two times a week, week after week, right?
sentences.zh: 这是一所大型公立大学，他们认为唯一能安全重新开放的方法就是每周对每位学生进行两次检测，周而复始，对吧？

sentences.en: That is a financial calculation.
sentences.zh: 这就是一种财务考量。

sentences.en: They're going to spend that money because they're trying to buy down risk.
sentences.zh: 他们愿意花这笔钱，因为他们试图以此降低风险。

sentences.en: And then there's the political calculation, right?
sentences.zh: 此外还有政治考量，对吧？

sentences.en: If you are a Republican governor in a largely Republican state where there is a debate over
sentences.zh: 如果你是一位共和党州长，身处一个共和党占多数的州，而那里正就

sentences.en: whether people should be required to wear masks or not, there might be other reasons why you decide
sentences.zh: 是否应该强制人们佩戴口罩存在争议，那么你决定

sentences.en: that you should reopen because your constituents want you to reopen and your president wants you to reopen.
sentences.zh: 重新开放可能还有其他原因，因为你的选民希望你重新开放，而你的总统也希望你重新开放。

sentences.en: Right.
sentences.zh: 没错。

sentences.en: And we saw Dr. Anthony Fauci, the top U.S.
sentences.zh: 我们看到美国顶级传染病专家安东尼·福奇博士

sentences.en: infectious disease expert, say recently that it is much more risky now for universities that have reopened and have large outbreaks to send
sentences.zh: 最近表示，对于那些已经重新开放并出现大规模疫情的大学来说，现在把

sentences.en: students home where they might spread the virus than to keep them there.
sentences.zh: 学生送回家反而比让他们留在学校更容易传播病毒。

sentences.en: And so we're seeing universities that in a sense fostered virus outbreaks by reopening have to keep the virus outbreaks under control by keeping students on campus.
sentences.zh: 所以我们看到，一些在某种程度上因重新开放而助长了疫情的大学，现在不得不通过让学生留在校园来控制疫情。

sentences.en: And Natasha, you're reporting on what happened to Zoe and the University of Alabama, you know, first published a few days ago.
sentences.zh: 娜塔莎，你报道了佐伊和阿拉巴马大学发生的事情，你知道，那是几天前首次发表的。

sentences.en: What has happened since then?
sentences.zh: 那之后发生了什么？

sentences.en: On the same day the story came out, you know, about eight hours later, the president of the University
sentences.zh: 就在报道出来的同一天，你知道，大约八小时后，阿拉巴马大学的校长

sentences.en: of Alabama sent out this message to students and faculty and staff and parents.
sentences.zh: 向学生、教职员工和家长发送了这条信息。

sentences.en: And what he said was that they were implementing these important new changes.
sentences.zh: 他所说的是，他们正在实施这些重要的新变革。

sentences.en: Did you know that the university sent out an email after the story came out that they're going to change quarantine and isolation?
sentences.zh: 你知道吗，在报道出来后，学校发了一封邮件，说他们要改变隔离和检疫政策？

sentences.en: I did not know that.
sentences.zh: 我不知道。

sentences.en: All right.
sentences.zh: 好吧。

sentences.en: Well, I'm just going to read it to you because I got an email from the president of U Alabama today.
sentences.zh: 嗯，我读给你听，因为我今天收到了阿拉巴马大学校长发来的邮件。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: I'm going to read it to you.
sentences.zh: 我读给你听。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: So dear students, faculty, staff, and parents, hoping your Labor Day weekend was safe and relaxing.
sentences.zh: 亲爱的学生、教职员工和家长们，希望你们的劳动节假期过得安全且放松。

sentences.en: I want to update you on COVID-19 steps we have implemented effective today.
sentences.zh: 我想向你们通报我们从今天起实施的关于新冠肺炎的措施。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: For our students who test positive and prepare to move to campus isolation spaces,
sentences.zh: 对于检测呈阳性并准备搬到校内隔离区的学生，

sentences.en: staffing and medical resources have been enhanced to ensure prompt communication and expanded services.
sentences.zh: 我们加强了人员配备和医疗资源，以确保及时的沟通和扩展的服务。

sentences.en: That's amazing.
sentences.zh: 太棒了。

sentences.en: Wow.
sentences.zh: 哇。

sentences.en: Okay.
sentences.zh: 好的。

sentences.en: That makes me so happy.
sentences.zh: 这让我太高兴了。

sentences.en: Congratulations, Zoe.
sentences.zh: 恭喜你，佐伊。

sentences.en: You've made the University of Alabama quarantine better.
sentences.zh: 你让阿拉巴马大学的隔离条件变得更好了。

sentences.en: Thank you.
sentences.zh: 谢谢。

sentences.en: Oh my gosh.
sentences.zh: 天哪。

sentences.en: That's so great.
sentences.zh: 太好了。

sentences.en: Oh, that makes me feel so much better for like people I know going into quarantine.
sentences.zh: 哦，这让我对那些即将进入隔离的人感到宽慰多了。

sentences.en: And if I have to go into quarantine again, like later on this year, oh, that makes me feel so much better.
sentences.zh: 如果今年晚些时候我不得不再次隔离，哦，这真的让我感觉好多了。

sentences.en: Thank you so much.
sentences.zh: 非常感谢。

sentences.en: I'm super happy that like I had a voice in all of this because at the beginning, when I first went into quarantine, I just sat in that room and
sentences.zh: 我超级高兴我能在这件事上发出声音，因为刚开始我第一次被隔离时，我只是坐在那个房间里

sentences.en: cried because I was like, nobody's going to hear like my story about this all.
sentences.zh: 哭，因为我觉得没有人会听到我关于这一切的故事。

sentences.en: Like nobody's going to know about this.
sentences.zh: 就像没有人会知道这件事一样。

sentences.en: And now that I actually like have a voice and people are going to hear about
sentences.zh: 而现在，我真的有了发言权，人们将会听到

sentences.en: this, I'm super thankful.
sentences.zh: 这件事，我超级感激。

sentences.en: In the latest reports from the University of Alabama, more than 2,500 students and nearly 1,200 faculty and staff have tested positive for the coronavirus over the past month.
sentences.zh: 根据阿拉巴马大学的最新报告，过去一个月里，有超过2500名学生和近1200名教职员工的新冠病毒检测呈阳性。

sentences.en: But in recent days, the school reports that the virus is slowing.
sentences.zh: 但据学校报告，最近几天病毒传播速度正在放缓。

sentences.en: And on Monday, they announced they were easing some of the rules around the lockdown on campus.
sentences.zh: 周一，他们宣布放宽了一些校园封锁的相关规定。

sentences.en: We'll be right back.
sentences.zh: 我们马上回来。

sentences.en: Here's what else you need to know today.
sentences.zh: 以下是你今天还需要知道的其他消息。

sentences.en: On the Gulf Coast, states are bracing for Hurricane Sally to make landfall near Alabama.
sentences.zh: 在墨西哥湾沿岸，各州正严阵以待，迎接飓风“萨利”在阿拉巴马州附近登陆。

sentences.en: The storm is expected to hit today.
sentences.zh: 预计风暴将于今天抵达。

sentences.en: Those who live on the Gulf Coast are all too familiar with Mother Nature's wrath.
sentences.zh: 居住在墨西哥湾沿岸的人们对大自然的愤怒再熟悉不过了。

sentences.en: We still hope and pray that Sally will not bring that type of pain and heartache.
sentences.zh: 我们仍然希望并祈祷“萨利”不会带来那种痛苦和心碎。

sentences.en: But my fellow Alabamians, Hurricane Sally is not to be taken for granted.
sentences.zh: 但我的阿拉巴马同胞们，飓风“萨利”绝不可掉以轻心。

sentences.en: With warnings of devastating floods and threats of tornadoes, Governor Kay Ivey of Alabama is urging residents along the coast to evacuate low-lying areas.
sentences.zh: 随着毁灭性洪水和龙卷风威胁的预警，阿拉巴马州州长凯·艾维敦促沿海居民撤离低洼地区。

sentences.en: Officials expect as much as 30 inches of rainfall in some places and storm surges as high as six to nine feet.
sentences.zh: 官员预计部分地区的降雨量将高达30英寸，风暴潮将高达6到9英尺。

sentences.en: On Tuesday, members of Breonna Taylor's family and city officials from Louisville, Kentucky said they had settled the wrongful death lawsuit brought on her behalf.
sentences.zh: 周二，布雷娜·泰勒的家属成员和肯塔基州路易斯维尔市的官员表示，他们已经就代表她提起的非正常死亡诉讼达成了和解。

sentences.en: As significant as today is, it's only the beginning of getting full justice for
sentences.zh: 尽管今天意义重大，但这只是为布雷娜

sentences.en: Breonna.
sentences.zh: 寻求全面正义的开始。

sentences.en: We must not lose focus on what the real drive is.
sentences.zh: 我们绝不能忘记真正的目标是什么。

sentences.en: And with that being said, it's time to move forward with the criminal charges because she deserves that and much more.
sentences.zh: 话虽如此，现在是时候推进刑事指控了，因为她理应得到这些，甚至更多。

sentences.en: As part of the settlement, the city will pay Taylor's family $12 million and promise sweeping police reform, but it acknowledged no wrongdoing.
sentences.zh: 作为和解协议的一部分，市政府将向泰勒的家人支付1200万美元并承诺进行彻底的警务改革，但并未承认任何不当行为。

sentences.en: A criminal investigation into the three officers who conducted the raid that resulted in Taylor's death is ongoing.
sentences.zh: 针对导致泰勒死亡的突袭行动的三名警官的刑事调查仍在进行中。

sentences.en: Her beautiful spirit and personality is working through all of us on the ground.
sentences.zh: 她美丽的灵魂和个性正在激励着我们所有在现场的人。

sentences.en: So please continue to say her name, Breonna Taylor.
sentences.zh: 所以请继续呼唤她的名字，布雷娜·泰勒。

sentences.en: That's it for The Daily.
sentences.zh: 以上就是《每日新闻》的全部内容。

sentences.en: I'm Megan
sentences.zh: 我是梅根

sentences.en: Tui.
sentences.zh: 图伊。

sentences.en: Michael Barbaro will be back next week.
sentences.zh: 迈克尔·巴巴罗下周将回来。

sentences.en: See you tomorrow.
sentences.zh: 明天见。

sentences.en: For decades, the Brooklyn Democratic Party operated as a tightly controlled machine until this summer, when elections ushered in a bunch of self-described reformers.
sentences.zh: 几十年来，布鲁克林民主党一直像一台严密控制的机器一样运作，直到今年夏天，选举迎来了一批自称改革派的人。

sentences.en: Ever since, the party has been in the grip of a bruising, chaotic, and sometimes thrilling fight.
sentences.zh: 从那以后，该党一直处于一场激烈、混乱，有时又令人兴奋的斗争之中。

sentences.en: In the latest episode of Metro with me, Sarah Koenig, stories of people trying to maintain their influence and losing control along the way.
sentences.zh: 在我和莎拉·凯尼格主持的最新一期《地铁》节目中，讲述了人们试图维持影响力却在过程中失去控制的故事。

sentences.en: Metro.
sentences.zh: 《地铁》。

sentences.en: Listen wherever you get your podcasts.
sentences.zh: 在任何你获取播客的地方收听。
